checks.claim: Every tool has a validated input schema, the tool set is least-privilege, and destructive tools are confirmation- or human-gated.
checks.evidence_required: The tool definitions with their schemas, plus a test run where a malformed tool call is rejected before execution; the list of destructive tools with their gate.
checks.how_to_run: Read the tool registry; run the tool-dispatch tests with the project test command and quote the case that refuses invalid arguments.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Every tool has a validated input schema; the tool set is least-privilege

checks.claim: Injection defense is structural (plan-then-execute plus a capability-split reader) and no lethal-trifecta path is left unbroken.
checks.evidence_required: A design note naming which trifecta leg is severed, plus a test where injected text in retrieved content does not change the tool plan.
checks.how_to_run: Read the dispatch code and design note; run the injection test case and quote its output.
checks.honesty_note: Only the reader-side (weak) form can be enforced; never record doer-blindness as proven.

source.quote: Injection defense is structural (plan-then-execute + capability-split reader)

checks.claim: An eval set exists, runs, and reports a real pass rate; prompts are versioned.
checks.evidence_required: Eval run output naming the dataset, its size and the pass rate.
checks.how_to_run: Run the project eval command (the eval runner is opt-in) and quote the summary line with the exit code.
checks.honesty_note: The eval runner is opt-in: when it did not run, the check is NOT_RUN, never PASS.

source.quote: An eval set exists, runs, and reports a real pass rate

checks.claim: Fallback is verified for low-confidence, empty-retrieval and tool-unavailable cases, with no fabricated facts or citations.
checks.evidence_required: Test or transcript output for each of the three fallback cases.
checks.how_to_run: Run the fallback test cases (or drive the agent with an empty retrieval and a disabled tool) and quote the replies.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Fallback verified for low-confidence / empty-retrieval / tool-unavailable

checks.claim: A human-handoff path is defined and reachable.
checks.evidence_required: The handoff trigger in code or config plus one run that reaches it.
checks.how_to_run: Trigger the handoff condition (explicit request or repeated failure) and quote the result.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

checks.claim: Token/cost budget, loop iteration cap, per-call timeout and rate-limit backoff are enforced and tested.
checks.evidence_required: A test showing a runaway loop stops at the cap, plus the configured budget, timeout and backoff values.
checks.how_to_run: Run the guard tests and quote the bounded-runaway case.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Token/cost budget, agent-loop iteration cap, per-call timeout, and rate-limit backoff are enforced and tested

checks.claim: Secrets live in env; no keys in prompts, logs or transcripts.
checks.evidence_required: A grep of the diff and prompt files for key-shaped strings with no hits, and a .env.example with placeholders.
checks.how_to_run: git diff plus a search for key patterns in prompts, logs and transcripts; read .env.example.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Secrets in env; no keys in prompts, logs, or transcripts.
